card.name: Linking words before tissue-damage terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, and, the, with, or the middle of inflamed, right after a tissue or body-site term (gingival, skin, ischemia, healing). The next word is likely to name soft tissue, such as mouth, tissue or subcutaneous.

modes.label: of after injury term
modes.description: The word of follows a tissue-damage term such as healing or ischemia.
modes.example: persistent jaw pain or slow healing<< of>> the mouth or jaw after dental surgery.

modes.label: and joining tissue names
modes.description: The word and joins paired tissue names in a heading.

modes.label: inside inflamed
modes.description: The pole fires partway through the word inflamed before tissue.
modes.example: large areas of denuded or infl<<amed>> tissue.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward writing 'soft' (as in soft tissue) next.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in lists of mouth, skin or tissue damage, where 'soft tissue' may come next.
